contentPattern: 1 row, 2 cells: image cell = photo (optional 2nd photo = mobile crop) | text cell = quote (h2 or a plain paragraph), attribution as italic-only paragraph(s) (e.g. '***Audrey***' line break '*Actual patient with lung cancer*'), CTA link (bold = button). Rendered as figure > blockquote + figcaption over the full-bleed photo; the quote mark is decorative CSS.
